title: 13 Value 4: picking value with color dockers

bites.title: Picking on purpose
bites.body: Krita's color dockers let you pick a value on purpose instead of by eye. Open Settings > Dockers > Advanced Color Selector if it isn't showing.

bites.title: 70% gray
bites.body: In the Advanced Color Selector, click a pure gray at about 70%. Keep it gray, no color.

bites.title: Exactly 20%
bites.body: Now open Settings > Dockers > Specific Color Selector. Switch it to HSV if needed, set saturation to 0 and value to 20. Typed, not guessed.

bites.title: Steal from the ladder
bites.body: Press {key:KritaSelected/KisToolColorSampler|P} and click the 56% swatch in the top row.

bites.title: 13 cleared
bites.body: By eye, by number, by sampling. Three ways to land a value.
